intro.name: The song
intro.text:
A nursing mother, (parent), is trying to settle (parent.his/her) infant for a nap. Nearby, (musician) has begun practicing a new song. The melody is {A}.
The baby {seems content|begins fussing|falls asleep|watches the musician with wide eyes}. An elder suggests an old lullaby, while an older child insists that (older.he/she) knows a better one.
What should the villagers do?

choices.label: Ask the musician to adapt the song to the family's needs.
Invite the elder and child to perform a quiet lullaby.

a1.text: The musician softens the melody. The baby settles, and the parent thanks (musician.him/her).

a2.text: The musician slows the song so much that everyone else nearly falls asleep too.

a3.text: The musician asks the parent what would help. The parent requests a little quiet instead, and the musician agrees.

a4.text: The musician tries to sing softly but keeps forgetting and bursting into a dramatic chorus. The group laughs and takes the rehearsal farther away.

f1.text: The elder sings a gentle tune remembered from childhood. The parent joins in quietly.

f2.text: The child sings with enormous confidence and almost no sense of pitch. The baby seems fascinated.

f3.text: The elder and child disagree over the words, then discover they learned different versions of the same song.

f4.text: The baby falls asleep before anyone begins. Everyone exchanges relieved looks and agrees not to make another sound.
